text: The Chair has called the following meetings of the Toronto Parking Authority - Audit and Risk Management Committee for 2022: Monday, February 7, 2022 - 9:30 a.m. Tuesday, May 10, 2022 - 1:30 p.m. Thursday, September 8, 2022 - 1:30 p.m. Tuesday, November 8, 2022 - 1:30 p.m. Toronto Parking Authority - Audit and Risk Management Committee meetings will be conducted by video conference. The Committee's meeting schedule is available on the City's website at www.toronto.ca/council .
The Toronto Parking Authority - Audit and Risk Management Committee received the item for information.
